stages.name: Question
stages.zh: 夹爪开合与横向移动，如何改变物体状态？
stages.en: How do gripper opening and position affect the object?

stages.name: Scene key
stages.zh: 这是学图用的探测操作，不是把物体放到绿色标记上的策略。
stages.en: These are graph-learning probes, not a policy for placing onto the green marker.

stages.name: Observational graph
stages.zh: 观测已给出 2 条方向；接下来用干预检验剩余虚线。
stages.en: Observations already orient two edges; interventions test the remaining dashed edges.

stages.name: Select 1
stages.zh: 操作 1：同一情境下，先闭合夹爪，再试张开。
stages.en: Operation 1: compare closed and open grippers in the same context.

stages.name: initial
stages.zh: 闭合夹爪再抬升；观察物体是否随夹爪上升。
stages.en: Close the gripper and lift; observe whether the object rises with it.

stages.name: Readout
stages.zh: 采样定格：物体处于搬运高度。
stages.en: Readout pause: object is at the transport height.

stages.name: lower_after_measurement
stages.zh: 采样结束；放回物体并撤回，回程不增加学图证据。
stages.en: Sampling complete; put down and retreat. Return motion adds no graph evidence.

stages.name: Paired reset
stages.zh: 配对试验：保持同一背景，只把夹爪改为张开。
stages.en: Matched trial: same context and motion, now with an open gripper.

stages.name: initial
stages.zh: 保持夹爪张开，执行相同移动；本次物体仍留在桌面。
stages.en: Keep the gripper open and repeat the motion; the object stays on the table.

stages.name: Readout
stages.zh: 采样定格：物体仍在桌面。
stages.en: Readout pause: object remains on the table.

stages.name: lower_after_measurement
stages.zh: 采样结束；空爪完成回程，物体没有被放下或重新抓取。
stages.en: Sampling complete; the empty gripper returns. The object was never lifted.

stages.name: Paired evidence
stages.zh: 同初态、同移动，开合改变抬升结果；整批 64 次操作用于定向。
stages.en: Same context and motion, different lift. All 64 operations support the orientation.

stages.name: Update 1
stages.zh: 新增 1 条方向：夹爪间距 → 物体高度。
stages.en: One new direction: opening → object height.

stages.name: Reset
stages.zh: 下一轮独立试验：重新初始化，上一轮图保留。
stages.en: New independent trial: reset the scene, retain the previous graph.

stages.name: Select 2
stages.zh: 操作 2：闭合抓取后改变横向位置，观察物体位置。
stages.en: Operation 2: grasp and change lateral position; observe the object.

stages.name: initial
stages.zh: 操作 2：闭合抓取后改变横向位置，观察物体位置。
stages.en: Operation 2: grasp and change lateral position; observe the object.

stages.name: Readout
stages.zh: 采样定格：物体处于搬运高度。
stages.en: Readout pause: object is at the transport height.

stages.name: lower_after_measurement
stages.zh: 采样结束；放回物体并撤回，回程不增加学图证据。
stages.en: Sampling complete; put down and retreat. Return motion adds no graph evidence.

stages.name: Update 2
stages.zh: 第二轮没有新增方向；保留原图，不强行补边。
stages.en: Round 2 adds no direction; retain the graph without inventing edges.

stages.name: Result
stages.zh: 学到 3 条方向，目标—匹配仍未定向；不等于完整真图。
stages.en: Three directed edges; target—alignment remains open. This is not complete recovery.

scope: Recorded graph-discovery illustration, not evidence for calibration benefits or complete causal identification.
presentation: Recomposited original robot frames; fixed cameras; English-only captions and labels; graph states from discovery logs. Static cards and explicit resets added. Timing follows original replay frame cadence, not a real-time physics claim.
